name: Language Visibility - Mercury Editor
description: provides a language-visibility behavior within Mercury Editor.
project_description:
In a multilingual site controlling languages in which a paragraph is visible to users while always making the paragraph visible in the editor can be helpful. This is especially important if the content is exported and imported programmatically to a translations service.

 Features 
 Provides a behavior which only renders the paragraph in selected languages, but always renders the paragraph on a Mercury Editor route.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, enable the behavior in the settings for selected paragraphs.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module enhances the Mercury Editor preview and requires that module as well.

 Similar projects 
 Paragraphs Language Visibility also selectively displays paragraphs in selected languages using the Entity access subsystem. Mercury Editor is a visual editor and so all paragraphs must be visible in the interface language or they cannot be edited. That makes this module unsuitable to be used with Mercury Editor.
